mutations.because: `assertStagingIntact` only proves the staging directory itself still exists — a sweep can land after that check and before the write it guards, including a fresh staging dir springing up in its place, empty of what this store staged. Without verifying every manifest-claimed file is actually present before `rm(finalDir)` + `rename`, `writeManifest` would commit that directory anyway, replacing a previously good package with one whose manifest lists files that are not there. The missing-file test pins that this commit is refused and the previous package survives byte-for-byte.
